remarks: Owners have enjoyed living in this great 2 BR, 2 BTH one flr elevator bldg.,high ceilings, built in 2008. Minutes to restaurants, train, bus & HWY and vibrant downtown Stamford. Open floor plan, LR/dining area & white EIK w/island, granite, SS appls, Samsung refrigerator 2022, LG W/D, microwave, GE Range, are newer appls. GE Dishwasher installed when built. LR has access to balcony as well as BR. Very large primary BTH, white tile & fixtures. 2nd BTH also has white tile. Gas heat & C/A. Inside parking garage, reserved space on P2, #91, included in rental price. Inside mail delivery, & packages distributed to unit. There is a gym, & a common room. Level 2 has an exterior park for enjoyment as well as BBQ grills for use. Secure & smoke free BLDG, excellent credit a must, no snapshot credit,NO PETS,Rent Spree Avail.
